evidence.claim: The case was triggered by a real-time model score of 0.66 for transaction 3631383 ($1,336.84) on card C07196-K2.
The flagged transaction 3631383 occurred in-person for $1,336.84 in billing region 205.0 on 2017-01-08 12:13:05.
Card C07196-K2 has 3 prior confirmed fraud cases, including 'card_not_present_new_device' (CC-0123) and 'out_of_region_use' (CC-4781, CC-4581), with the most recent confirmed fraud on 2016-10-13.
The card C07196-K2 has 1 prior risk-score alert that was cleared as 'confirmed travel' (CC-5401) after customer confirmation, which had the same shape as this alert.
Billing region 205.0 for transaction 3631383 is known to card C07196-K2, with 8 prior transactions over 7 days since 2016-07-04; the card's modal region is 299.0 and it has used 38 regions total.
The episode includes 13 transactions from 2017-01-02 to 2017-01-08, showing mixed-channel activity with both in-person (e.g., 3631430, 3631383) and online (e.g., 3631398, 3631420) purchases.
One transaction in the episode (3631420, $40.56, online) on 2017-01-05 used a New device profile ('Windows | NULL | chrome 62.0 | NULL').

The calibrated memory-informed `cms_p` score for all 13 transactions in the candidate episode chain are low, with the flagged transaction 3631383 having a `cms_p` of 0.011555 and the highest `cms_p` in the chain being 0.016594 for transaction 3631421.

case.summary: Verdict is uncertain (p=0.35) for an account takeover pattern involving 13 mixed-channel transactions totaling $1,336.84. Conflicting evidence includes prior confirmed fraud cases and new device use vs. a cleared travel alert and low calibrated probability. A customer validation request received no reply, leading to recommended DECLINE_TRANSACTION (L1), MONITOR_CARD (auto), and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto).
